draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and direct, describing the body or a surface
notes: Irregular neuter noun taking a -τ- in the genitive singular (του δέρματος) and in the plural (τα δέρματα).
Do not confuse with 'η φλούδα', which refers to the peel or skin of fruit and vegetables, or 'η πέτσα', used for the skin on cooked meat (like chicken) or milk.

senses.definition: The natural outer covering of a human or animal body.
